issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按卡片 md 抓到 20f——雷达扫描（30–90f）一帧都没进画，看到的只是一张静止页面
指针只是一根从屏心顶到画外的硬线，没有枢轴，像是从虚空里长出来，外端硬生生截在画外
扫过的区域瞬间就是新页，没有任何余辉，“扫描刷新”缺少时间感
亮线暗描边用纯黑 rgba(0,0,0,0.55)，与 Phase 0 页面的带色相深色不协调；SVG 无实例化 ID
changes: 补 CLOCK_WIPE_DURATION = 150（前态 30 + 扫描 60 + 淡出 6 + 真静止 54）；屏心 (960,540)、R1400、73 顶点扇形、30–90f 纯 linear 0→360°、四层亮线宽度/透明度、90–96f 淡出与 96f 摘罩全部保持
指针身后拖一道 36° 雷达余辉扇（强调色 0→0.13 conic 渐变，只铺在已扫过的 B 侧，扫满前长度随角度增长、不越过 12 点），与亮线同步淡出卸载
屏心补指针枢轴：深色芯 + 3px 白环 + 强调色圆点 + 软投影，22–30f 以 overshoot 弹出做预备，90–96f 随亮线淡出、96f 卸载
指针用 SVG 遮罩做外端渐隐（70% 后渐隐到 0），暗描边改带色相的 rgba(10,11,18,0.55)；渐变/遮罩 ID 用 useId 实例化
issuesEn: No duration constant; the workbench picked 20f from the card md, so the radar sweep (30–90f) never appeared — viewers saw a static page
The hand was a hard line from screen centre to beyond the frame with no pivot, as if growing out of nothing, and was abruptly cut off at the edge
Swept areas became the new page instantly with no afterglow, so the scan-and-refresh idea had no sense of time
The dark outline was pure black rgba(0,0,0,0.55), clashing with the Phase 0 tinted darks; SVG ids were not instance-unique
changesEn: Added CLOCK_WIPE_DURATION = 150 (30 lead-in + 60 sweep + 6 fade + 54 true hold); the (960,540) centre, R1400, 73-vertex fan, linear 0→360° over 30–90f, four-layer line widths/opacities, 90–96f fade and 96f unmount are unchanged

A 36° radar afterglow trails the hand (accent conic gradient 0→0.13, only on the already-swept B side; its length grows with the angle before the first full turn so it never crosses 12 o'clock), fading and unmounting with the line
A pivot hub at screen centre: dark core, 3px white ring, accent dot and soft shadow; it pops in with overshoot at 22–30f as anticipation, fades with the line at 90–96f and unmounts at 96f
The hand fades out toward its outer end through an SVG mask (from 70% to 0); the dark outline is the tinted rgba(10,11,18,0.55); gradient/mask ids are made unique with useId
